hook.line: You can now get your business to rank and show up in a ChatGPT search.
hook.visual: Top half: blog article titled 'Can Chat GPT See Your Business?'; bottom half: presenter at a mic with yellow-highlighted word-by-word captions on the seam

beats.what: Claim: your business can now rank in ChatGPT search, over the article headline
Names it: generative engine optimization, like SEO; article scrolls to 'What GEO looks like'
ChatGPT doesn't crawl like Google; article shows the list of sources it uses
Article scrolls to the line about missing or inconsistent business info: AI won't rank you
'Take a screenshot' prompt, then the tips list (real customer questions, structure, FAQ) fills the top half
Scrolls further to a real-life client example section while he finishes the tips
Cut to his TikTok profile page as he says 'follow'

why_it_works: The article on top acts as a citation, so the claim reads as reported fact rather than opinion
'Take a screenshot' cue flags the list as the save-worthy part and drives saves
Captions sit on the seam between the article and the face, so the eye stays in one spot while both halves change
Cutting to the profile page on 'follow' shows exactly where to tap
weaknesses: Article text is far too small to read on a phone; the screenshot prompt points at an illegible list
The face half never changes framing; all motion comes from scrolling a page
Transcript slips ('chat should be so you can find') suggest a single unedited take
for_robert: End on a cut to his own profile while saying 'follow' - Fred could point at the follow button - but put any list he wants saved in big text, not a scrolled article.
